title: W00: freeze contracts, pins, schema names and task split
description: Freeze every W00-owned contract from the plan: InvocationContext, WorkerContext, CommitEvidence, ReconcileGitCommitData, ProjectRegistration, the worker binding, the transfer surface, the snapshot/detail/thread/history surface, the new event names and the new diagnostic names. Re-verify the Hermes build identity (install-stamp commit against the adjacent checkout commit) and re-check the mechanisms of plan 12.5 at the pinned revision before any dependent task starts. Record the acceptance-group to task mapping from plan 16.
acceptance: Every identifier another task consumes is frozen by name in one place, with its owning W package named.
Hermes build identity is re-checked and recorded with the install-stamp commit, the adjacent checkout commit, and whether they match at the time of the check.
Each acceptance group A01-A18 is mapped to exactly one owning task, and each mapped criterion appears in that task's acceptance list.
No source file changes; the deliverable is contract text plus the frozen pin.
notes: Start from plan sections 4, 6-10, 11.2, 14, 15 and 16. The audit records what was verified and what remains unproven; treat the unproven gates as open work, not as settled facts.
